targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  event_date AS TIME,
  count() AS uninstalls
FROM analytics_events
WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
  AND event_name = 'app_remove'
  AND event_date >= toDate('${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
  AND event_date <= toDate('${__to:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
GROUP BY event_date
ORDER BY event_date

SELECT
  event_date AS TIME,
  count() AS updates
FROM analytics_events
WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
  AND event_name = 'app_update'
  AND event_date >= toDate('${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
  AND event_date <= toDate('${__to:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
GROUP BY event_date
ORDER BY event_date

SELECT
  event_date AS TIME,
  count() AS os_updates
FROM analytics_events
WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
  AND event_name = 'os_update'
  AND event_date >= toDate('${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
  AND event_date <= toDate('${__to:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
GROUP BY event_date
ORDER BY event_date

SELECT
  event_date AS TIME,
  count() AS
EXCEPTIONS
FROM analytics_events
WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
  AND event_name = 'app_exception'
  AND event_date >= toDate('${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
  AND event_date <= toDate('${__to:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
GROUP BY event_date
ORDER BY event_date

SELECT
  event_name,
  count() AS total_events,
  uniqExact(user_pseudo_id) AS unique_users,
  round(count() / greatest(dateDiff('day', toDate('${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD}'), toDate('${__to:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')) + 1, 1), 2) AS events_per_day
FROM analytics_events
WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
  AND event_name IN (
                       'app_remove',
                       'app_update',
                       'os_update',
                       'app_exception',
                       'app_clear_data')
  AND event_date >= toDate('${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
  AND event_date <= toDate('${__to:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
GROUP BY event_name
ORDER BY total_events DESC

panels.title: Avg Event Distance to App Remove (Same-Day Uninstallers)

targets.rawSql:
WITH same_day_uninstall_users AS (
  SELECT
    i.user_pseudo_id,
    i.event_date
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id, event_date
    FROM analytics_events
    WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
      AND event_name = 'first_open'
      AND event_date >= toDate('${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
      AND event_date <= toDate('${__to:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
  ) i
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id, event_date
    FROM analytics_events
    WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
      AND event_name = 'app_remove'
      AND event_date >= toDate('${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
      AND event_date <= toDate('${__to:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
  ) r ON i.user_pseudo_id = r.user_pseudo_id AND i.event_date = r.event_date
),
target_sessions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    e.user_pseudo_id,
    e.param_ga_session_id
  FROM analytics_events e
  INNER JOIN same_day_uninstall_users u
    ON e.user_pseudo_id = u.user_pseudo_id
    AND e.event_date = u.event_date
  WHERE e.import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
    AND e.param_ga_session_id IS NOT NULL
),
session_events AS (
  SELECT
    e.user_pseudo_id,
    e.param_ga_session_id,
    e.event_name,
    e.event_timestamp,
    row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY e.user_pseudo_id, e.param_ga_session_id ORDER BY e.event_timestamp) AS rn
  FROM analytics_events e
  INNER JOIN target_sessions s
    ON e.user_pseudo_id = s.user_pseudo_id
    AND e.param_ga_session_id = s.param_ga_session_id
  WHERE e.import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
),
remove_positions AS (
  SELECT
    user_pseudo_id,
    param_ga_session_id,
    rn AS remove_rn
  FROM session_events
  WHERE event_name = 'app_remove'
),
event_distances AS (
  SELECT
    se.event_name,
    abs(toInt64(se.rn) - toInt64(rp.remove_rn)) AS distance
  FROM session_events se
  INNER JOIN remove_positions rp
    ON se.user_pseudo_id = rp.user_pseudo_id
    AND se.param_ga_session_id = rp.param_ga_session_id
)
SELECT
  event_name,
  round(avg(distance), 2) AS avg_distance_to_app_remove,
  min(distance) AS min_distance,
  max(distance) AS max_distance,
  count() AS event_count
FROM event_distances
GROUP BY event_name
ORDER BY avg_distance_to_app_remove ASC
